why_this_order: the margin is the only quantity the standings support on its own; a total needs the same inputs but a moneyline needs the margin distribution as well
failure_mode_if_reordered: a total quoted first silently fixes the margin through the two-team expectation, so the side stops being an independent decision

why_this_order: the total is the sum of the two expectations the side already chose; it must not re-estimate them
failure_mode_if_reordered: re-deriving the split after choosing the total moves the side the reader just saw, so the two numbers are no longer one model

may_start_from: published side AND published total, plus the measured dispersion
why_this_order: the moneyline is a probability computed from the two published lines and a noise scale measured on final scores; it cannot exist before them
failure_mode_if_reordered: pricing the moneyline from the raw margin instead of the published rounded line makes the side and the moneyline contradict each other on the same row
